context: A uni student lends a book to a teen friend and discusses it
purpose: Teach: 著書/書評/購読/補足/創設/学科/学年/知人

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: これ、貸すね。先月読んだ本なんだけど、結構面白かったよ。著者の最新の著書らしい。
lines.en: Here, I'll lend it to you. It's a book I read last month — pretty interesting. Apparently it's the author's latest work.
lines.style: Warm casual senpai tone, slightly enthusiastic about sharing a recommendation.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ありがとう!えっと、誰が書いたの?有名な人?
lines.en: Thanks! Um, who wrote it? Someone famous?
lines.style: Bright teen curiosity, friendly and a little playful.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: うちの学科の先生の知人らしくて、新聞の書評欄でも結構評価されてたんだよ。
lines.en: Apparently he's an acquaintance of a professor in my department — got solid reviews in the newspaper's book review section too.
lines.style: Casual explaining tone, slightly proud of the inside connection.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: へぇ、すごい。私、新聞とか購読してないから全然知らなかった。
lines.en: Wow, impressive. I don't subscribe to any newspapers so I had no idea.
lines.style: Light self-deprecating teen honesty, casual surprise.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 後ろの方に著者の補足説明があって、その人が研究所を創設した経緯とかも書いてあるよ。
lines.en: There's a supplementary note from the author at the back — it even covers how he founded his research institute.
lines.style: Helpful guiding tone, like pointing out the best parts of the book.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: え、まだ高校生だからちょっと難しいかも…ちゃんと読めるかな。
lines.en: Eh, since I'm still in high school it might be a bit tough… I wonder if I can actually read it.
lines.style: Hesitant teenage worry, slightly embarrassed laugh implied.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 大丈夫、漢字には全部ふりがな振ってあるし、分からないとこは聞いてくれていいよ。
lines.en: It's fine — all the kanji have furigana, and you can ask me anything you don't get.
lines.style: Reassuring older friend, kind and patient with the younger one.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: じゃあ頑張って読んでみる!来年の学年が上がるまでには絶対読み終える!
lines.en: Okay, I'll do my best to read it! I'll definitely finish it before I move up a grade next year!
lines.style: Energized teen resolve, cheerful and motivated declaration.
